description: Financial statements to normalised JSON: income statement, balance sheet and cash flow per period (IFRS, US GAAP, PCG, CGNC...), audit opinion and key notes, plus ratios computed in code (growth, margins, ROE, net debt/EBITDA, interest cover, current and quick ratios, DSO/DIO/DPO, FCF and cash conversion), balance checks and graded flags. Up to 25 PDF pages / 2.5 MB / 100k characters (larger: /financials/pro). Long jobs return a free poll URL. Documents are not stored. Price: $0.99 USDC per call, paid with x402 on Base.

docType.description: Optional hint: auto, term_sheet, safe_or_convertible, shareholders_agreement, loi_or_offer, spa_or_apa, nda

language.description: Optional output language: auto, en, fr, es, de, it, pt, nl, ar; default auto (language of the document)

perspective.description: Optional, red flags only: whose side to review for (neutral, investor, founder, company, buyer, seller, lender, borrower, minority_shareholder, majority_shareholder); default neutral

text.description: Document text (min 200 characters). Send exactly one of text, url, pdf_base64.

url.description: https link to the document (PDF, HTML or plain text)
